Silkeborg is a Danish municipality evaluated in the Annual Report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database for the period of July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, published by the Regions' Clinical Quality Development Programme (RKKP) [^src1][^src2]. The report assesses the clinical quality of atrial fibrillation treatment across all 98 Danish municipalities, emphasizing the decentralized responsibility for healthcare quality development and local benchmarking within the Danish healthcare system [^src1][^src2].

Silkeborg is specifically highlighted for its strong performance regarding Indicator 4b, which measures compliance with safety practices for patients using DOAC (Direct Oral Anticoagulant) medications [^src1]. The municipality successfully met the standard for this indicator, achieving a compliance rate of 96.3% (1,549 out of 1,608 eligible patients) [^src1]. This result, which carries a 95% confidence interval of 95.3% to 97.2%, is marked as "Yes" for meeting the target and ranks among the highest values recorded in the report [^src1]. 

In addition to Indicator 4b, Silkeborg's data is also detailed in the context of other clinical metrics, such as the early initiation of anticoagulation therapy or the prevention of ischemic stroke (Indicators 1 and 5) [^src2]. For this specific measure, the municipality recorded a rate of 0.5% (10 out of 2,203 patients), with a confidence interval of 0.2% to 0.8%, alongside a secondary calculation of 0.6% (13 out of 2,176) [^src2]. These detailed municipal breakdowns provide a comprehensive view of the local adherence to national treatment guidelines and safety monitoring protocols [^src1][^src2].
